opening.argument: The central presentation is a tutorial for entering reward codes through named Binance app features. Viewers are told to open the app, select Binance Pay, choose Crypto Box or Red Packet, and enter the codes shown; the sampled interface displays a Red Packet code-entry field. The description also promotes free and “unlimited” crypto and directs viewers to Telegram for more codes. Those claims warrant caution, but the supplied evidence connects them to code distribution and a chance of a gift, not an established deceptive transaction. The claimed redemptions and code validity remain unconfirmed.
